headlines.title: השר כ"ץ על התקיפות החריגות בעזה: "נעצר מחבל בכיר בחמאס"
headlines.snippet: Iran's President stated that the country is working towards an agreement with the US, and that war is not beneficial to their goals. The Jordanian army reported intercepting eight missiles that entered its airspace.
